verdict.rationale: LangGraph supports durable, long-running execution with checkpointing, fault-tolerant resumption, and production deployment via Agent Server/CLI, which enables autonomous background-running automations, and this is corroborated by GitHub docs. However, it's a developer framework requiring custom setup (schedulers, triggers) rather than a built-in 'set up an automation' UX, and there's no evidence of native scheduling/triggering or a no-code way to configure autonomous background jobs. missing for 10: built-in scheduler/trigger mechanism for autonomous background runs, independent hands-on evidence of long-running unattended automations, first-party UI/no-code automation setup.
